Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIXT.1.1 (Always unencrypted, must be first field in message)

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: (Always unencrypted, must be second field in message)

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: (Always unencrypted, must be third field in message)

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Integer message sequence number. Sequence numbers are initialized at the start of each FIX session starting at 1 (one) and increment throughout the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request. Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: SenderCompID as assigned by Nasdaq Nordic (MPID in INET, FIX Session ID in NDTS). Outbound from Nasdaq: From 56 on the original inbound message.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: Trader ID (User ID). This tag is not required on session level messages but is required for application level messages. Outbound from Nasdaq: INET: Indicator to denote which host system was involved (S = Order message, T = Trade Reporting message). NDTS: N/A

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: UTC. Outbound from Nasdaq: Please note that this time is the time the message left the FIX application. It has no relevancy to execution time, reject time, or cancel time in the destination systems.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: As per the information provided by Nasdaq Nordic. Outbound from Nasdaq: From 49 on the original inbound message.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: INET: Required 1-character that identifies this entry as an order entry or trade reporting message (S = Order message, T = Trade Reporting message). NDTS: Optional indicator to denote client software version. Outbound from Nasdaq: Receiving party's Trader ID (User ID), if this message is a query/response message. From 50 on the original inbound message. Not specified for On-Behalf-Of message responses. This tag is not required on session level messages.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: Ignored. Outbound from Nasdaq: N/A

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: Service Bureaus use this field to submit their customer's MPID. This value will be returned to you in tag 128 on the outbound message. Please note that while it is possible for you submit a chain of transactions with inconsistent values for this tag in different messages, you are strongly advised not to do so. Outbound from Nasdaq: N/A

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: When applicable, this tag holds the User ID (Trader ID) for the on behalf of firm. Outbound from Nasdaq: N/A

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resent as a result of a ResendRequest. If data is not available set to same value as SendingTime. UTC

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: N/A. Outbound from Nasdaq: For drop and service bureau on behalf of messages, this field contains the service bureau's customer's MPID.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: N/A. Outbound from Nasdaq: For drop and service bureau on behalf of messages, this field contains the value entered in tag 116 on the inbound message.

Field.Name: DeliverToLocationID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: N/A. Outbound from Nasdaq: For drop messages, this field (if provided) specify the account / port ID used when originally sending the message. Use together with OrigClOrdID [41] and DeliverToCompID [128] to chain an order modification to the original order.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Where possible, coded message that includes an indicator and text to explain reason for rejection: Invalid tag number; Required tag missing; Tag not defined for this message type; Undefined Tag; Tag specified without a value; Value is incorrect (out of range) for tag; Incorrect data format for value; Signature problem; Tag CompID problem; SendingTime accuracy problem; Invalid value for MsgType tag; Repeating group fields out of order; Incorrect number in group count for repeating group

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. It is the TestReqID received from the Test Request message.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat Interval in seconds - should be greater than 10 and less than or equal to 60.

Field.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Field.Description: The default version of FIX messages used in this session.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Beginning sequence number of Requested Message

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Ending sequence number of Requested Message

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of a trade capture report. Must be unique per day per connector across all messages. 20-character alphanumeric. Price and quantity validations may be bypassed by resubmitting a previously rejected trade report with the same TradeReportID.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Used to identify message type, type of trade report.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Specifies how the TradeCaptureReport should be handled by the respondent.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Required for trade break requests, [856] = 7 and not applicable in other cases. Specifies the identifier of the locked-in trade to be broken.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Currency in which the price is expressed.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill. Limited to 18 digits and max 17 decimals. Mandatory, except when TradePriceCondiition is 17 (PNDG) or 18 (NOAP) in which case it should not be set

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Quantity bought/sold on this transaction. Limited to 18 digits and max 17 decimals. For transactions reported in instruments with MiFIR ID 'BOND' or 'SFPS' the reported value should be equal to transaction Notional Amount.

Field.Name: PriceType
Field.Description: Required for instruments with MIFIR ID: BOND, SFPS and DERV with CFI codes starting with 'FFD', 'SR' and 'JR'. Trades in these instrument types will not be accepted with trade type 'Monetary value'.

Field.Name: AssetType
Field.Description: For emission allowances (EMAL) and emission allowance derivatives (DERV|EMAL) only

Field.Name: TradeClearingInstruction
Field.Description: If not set (default) - Exclude from central counterpart.

Field.Name: StrikeValue
Field.Description: Transaction notional amount. Should be populated for Derivatives transactions. (Calculated by Nasdaq on outbound message if not reported).

Field.Name: StrikeCurrency
Field.Description: Currency in which the notional is denominated.

Field.Name: UnitOfMeasure
Field.Description: The unit of measure of the underlying commodity upon which the contract is based.

Field.Name: UnitOfMeasureQty
Field.Description: Used to indicate the quantity of the underlying commodity unit of measure on which the contract is based.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time when the message was initiated/released by the trader or the trading system.

Field.Name: VenueType
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT Level 1 - Market Mechanism

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT Level 2 - Trading Mode

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Type of trade. Corresponds to MMT Level 3.1 - Transaction Type: Transaction Category

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT Level 3.3 - Transaction Type: Agency Cross Trade Indicator. ACTX flag is not applicable from 2026-03-02.

Field.Name: SecondaryTrdType
Field.Description: Type of trade. Used in addition to TrdType [828].

Field.Name: TertiaryTrdType
Field.Description: Type of trade. Used in addition to TrdType [828] and SecondaryTrdType [855].

Field.Name: ExecMethod
Field.Description: Specifies how the transaction was executed. Corresponds to MMT Level 3.7 - Transaction Type: Off-Book Automated Indicator

Field.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Field.Description: By including 1390=2 on the inbound message and not including Tags 2668, 2669, 2670 and 7570, INET will automatically apply deferred publication (for all asset classes). The deferral will be applied from the reported time of agreement (Tag 769). Trades that cannot benefit from a deferred publication will be disseminated immediately. For RTS 1 instruments where the trade notional amount is large enough to be allowed for deferred publication, Nasdaq will determine the applicable deferral and publication time is indicated in outbound RptTime message. Trades are deferred in accordance with RTS 1. From 2026-03-02, trade publication deferrals for bonds will be based on Bond Type, Oustanding Amount, Trade Size and Credit Rating. Deferral durations for instruments with MiFIR ID BOND, SFPS, ETNS and ETCS are listed in section 6 of Nasdaq APA Service Description. For other RTS 2 instruments, Nasdaq determines the applicable deferral on either trade size and/or liquidity status.

Field.Name: RegulatoryReportType
Field.Description: Type of regulatory report. Sovereign Bonds eligible for supplementary volume omission deferral will be get flag 'OMIS' populated automatically if deferred publication has been requested under tag 1390. Corresponds to MMT Level 4.2 - Post Trade Deferral or Enrichment: Type

Field.Name: InvestorCountryOfResidence
Field.Description: The ISO 366 Country code (2 character) identifying which country the beneficial investor is resident. Defaults to the reporting firms nationality.

Field.Name: TotNumTrdRpts
Field.Description: Integer. Number of trades in package or behind publication of sovereign bond trades benefiting from supplementary deferral under 'AGFW' flag. When publishing Sovereign Bond trades with deferral using supplementary deferral 'Four Weeks Aggregation flag', the trade reporting party need to report the volume weighted price in tag 31, the full aggregated volume in tag 32 and 1934 = 37 'AGFW'.

Field.Name: RptTime
Field.Description: Requested Publication time. Any requested value in incoming AE message will have priority over Nasdaq determined deferral times.

Field.Name: PreviouslyReported
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT Level 5.1 - Reporting Circumstance: Duplication within Jurisdiction

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Identification of the third-country trading venue where the transaction was executed (MIC code).

Field.Name: CrdRtg
Field.Description: Used to determine the deferral duration for Corporate, Convertible and Other Bonds issued in EUR, USD and GBP. VarChar(4). If no value is set for reported transactions in the abovementioned bond types, the field will be defaulted to 'IG' (Investment Grade). Trade Reporting parties can either report 'IG' for Investment Grade or 'HY' for High Yield or report the rating. Ratings in table 1 of Nasdaq APA Service Description will be translated accordingly.

Field.Name: RptTime
Field.Description: As per the Trade Report or as set by Nasdaq

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Transaction type. Corresponds to MMT Level 3.4 - Transaction Type: Modification Indicator

Field.Name: TrdRptStatus
Field.Description: Status of Trade Report. Only applicable when the venue confirms the receipt of a TCR sent by the client.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: In applicable cases, specifies the cause of the reject

Field.Name: TradeReportRefID
Field.Description: Contains the value indicated in TradeReportID [571] in the original trade entry message.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Specifies how the TradeCaptureReport should be handled by the respondent. Inbound to Nasdaq Nordic limited to 1.

Field.Name: RptTime
Field.Description: As per the Trade Report or as set by Nasdaq

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Transaction type. Corresponds to MMT Level 3.4 - Transaction Type: Modification Indicator

Field.Name: TradePriceCondition
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT Level 3.6 - Transaction Type: Special Dividend Indicator, MMT Level 3.1 - Transaction Type: Transaction Category and MMT Level 3.8 - Transaction Type: Contributing to price formation or the price discovery process

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationReason
Field.Description: Flags are set automatically on outbound message if the Trade Reporting Party has requested deferral under tag 1390 and the trade qualifies for deferred publication. Corresponds to MMT Level 4.1 - Publication Mode / Post-Trade Deferral: Reason. Values 6, 7 and 8 are not valid for bonds, ETNs, ETCS and SFPS from 2026-03-02, from which date 18 to 23 apply for Bonds (MMT Level 4.1) and 24 is added for ETCs, ETNs, SFPs and emission allowances. The existing flags in tag 2670 will no longer be possible to submit for MiFIR ID 'BOND'. Bond trades reported with flags 'LRGS', 'ILQD' or 'SSTI' will be rejected.
